title: Film Thickness Measurement - Corrosion Detection on 5D Analyzer
subtitle: Pre-Bonding Quality Validation for 22nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Wei Zhang

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the 5D Analyzer system to detect and classify Corrosion defects during pre-bonding inspection at the 22nm technology node. The test is conducted at Singapore Fab 7 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 300mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Corrosion defects that are critical to yield at the 22nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the 5D Analyzer platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: 5D Analyzer
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Corrosion
- Process Step: Pre-Bonding
- Wafer Size: 300mm
- Technology Node: 22nm
- Fab Location: Singapore Fab 7

This test case applies to all 5D Analyzer systems deployed at Singapore Fab 7 for pre-bonding monitoring in the 22nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: 5D Analyzer
Software Version: v12.8.277
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_22nm_PRE_BONDING
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (87 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.5μm
Edge Exclusion: 3mm
Sampling Plan: 5-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the 5D Analyzer system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Corrosion defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 22nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 54 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 99% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.7% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.95 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-08-02
Wafers Tested: 28
Total Defects Found: 2088
Defect Density: 295.39 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 7.7%
Capture Rate: 93.0%
Test Duration: 263 minutes
System Uptime: 97.0%

Result Classification: NEEDS REVIEW
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The 5D Analyzer demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Corrosion at the 22nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate exceeds the target threshold; recipe tuning is recommended.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) SECS/GEM communication was verified with zero packet loss during data transfer.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
